Literal Markdown punctuation is escaped while converted emphasis and code stay formatted

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { content: { escapeAsterisks: true, escapeMisc: true, extractMetadata: false }, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.markdown?.content);
}

void main();
```
